acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible truncation of the upper caudal lobe; the superior portion of the tail fin exhibits a blunt, shortened silhouette with an irregular terminal edge, indicating significant distal tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of discrete, high-luminance circular pixel clusters (spots) on the lateral surface of the caudal peduncle, localized between the second dorsal fin and the caudal fin base.
